question: Rohan starts from Point A and drives 4 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 6 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 3 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8c91f494433b0420cbc81251297caf170c98808b7816b8ce783c8119c6e8407.png] 

Shortest distance between P and A = 3 + 6 + 4 = **13 km**

Point A is in **West **direction of Point P.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
